de: The most common defects of country houses include problems with the foundation, bearing structures and waterproofing. This is with reference to the interviewed representatives of the industry reports RIA Real Estate

de: Russia has repeatedly stressed that it does not seek a temporary truce in Ukraine, but wants to achieve long-term peace in the country. This was stated by the press Secretary of the President of Russia Vladimir Putin Dmitry Peskov, his words pass…

de: On the Russian market under the order began to supply a new compact frame SUV Toyota Land Cruiser FJ, the minimum price of which is about seven million rubles. Individual proposals reach 11 million rubles

t: Выявлена неожиданная польза популярной пищевой добавки
d: Рыбий жир может не только поддерживать здоровье сердца и сосудов, но и помогать организму бороться с воспалением. К такому выводу пришел исследователь Дуо Ли, обобщивший научные данные о влиянии омега-3 жирных кислот на организм человека
te: Unexpected benefits of a popular food additive
de: Fish oil can not only support the health of the heart and blood vessels, but also help the body fight inflammation. To this conclusion came the researcher Duo Lee, summarizing the scientific data on the effect of omega-3 fatty acids on the human body.

de: The Kontinental Hockey League has determined the best hockey players of the tenth game week of the regular season-2026/27. This is reported on the website of the KHL

de: The head of the German Hockey Union, Frank Lutz (DEB), called on the International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) to decide as soon as possible on the admission of the Russian national team to participate in the 2027 World Cup. This is reported on the website of the organization.

de: The Council of the European Union (EU) has approved the allocation of almost eight billion euros of financial assistance to Ukraine, which will be the largest one-time payment to Kiev under the Ukraine Facility program. This is reported in the press release of the EU Council

t: В Госдуме напомнили о требовании России к НАТО

de: Vologda, Ryazan, Kirov and Suzdal. This is stated in the study of the service for travel planning OneTwoTrip, which was at the disposal of “Tape.ru”

de: At two enterprises of the Rostov region, the elimination of fires caused by drone strikes of the Armed Forces of Ukraine (AFU) continues. This was announced by the Governor of the Russian region Yuri Slyusar in the Telegram channel

de: When copying files to Windows, the indicator can stop at 99 percent for a long time, which is associated with the operation of the disk. This is reported by the publication MakeUseOf

de: Azerbaijan is a reliable and active partner of the North Atlantic Alliance (NATO), said Hikmet Hajiyev, assistant to the President of the country Ilham Aliyev, following a meeting with the special representative of the bloc for the Caucasus and Central Asia Kevin…

te: In Russia put up for sale for one ruble old mansion
de: An ancient merchant mansion with more than 200 years of history was put up for sale in the city of Pavlovo, Nizhny Novgorod region. This was reported in Telegram by the Deputy Governor of the region Yegor Polyakov

t: Компании в России начали экономить на 13-й зарплате
d: Доля российских компаний, которые не планируют в 2026 году выплачивать сотрудникам новогоднюю премию или так называемую 13-ю зарплату, выросла до 32 процентов. Об этом со ссылкой на результат опроса SuperJob пишет «Коммерсантъ»
te: Companies in Russia began to save on the 13th salary
de: The share of Russian companies that do not plan to pay employees a New Year’s bonus or the so-called 13th salary in 2026 has risen to 32 percent. About this with reference to the result of the survey SuperJob writes “Kommersant”

t: Россия пообещала ответить на атаку ВСУ на Крымский мост

te: Russia promised to respond to the attack of the APU on the Crimean bridge
de: The Armed Forces of Russia will not be forced to wait with the answer for the attack of the Armed Forces of Ukraine (AFU) on the Crimean bridge. This was stated by Hero of Russia, Major General Sergey Lipova in an interview with aif.ru

t: Число отмененных из-за технического сбоя рейсов в США превысило 17 тысяч
d: Число отмененных в США рейсов превысило 17 тысяч. Этот сбой стал самым масштабным в стране за последние 35 лет среди инцидентов, вызванных техническими неполадками, сообщает Bloomberg со ссылкой на данные сервисов Flighty и Cirium
te: The number of canceled flights in the United States due to technical failure exceeded 17 thousand
